finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If m_name contains shell metacharacters or special commands, they could be injected into the command line that opens the file.
finding.assumptions: The file name construction involves user-controlled input (m_name) and the file is opened using a system call that might interpret the file name in a shell-like manner.
